title: A reported successful settlement commits whatever the status line says
description: SPEC §5.3: if payment settlement is reported successful but the resource response is unusable, the spend remains committed and the SDK raises ResourceDeliveryError with paid=true. Four unusable responses carry a successful PAYMENT-RESPONSE here — a 403 refusal, a 500, a 302, and a fresh 402 with attempts still remaining — and every one of them commits. The 402 is the sharpest of the four: a re-challenge is normally the one piece of evidence strong enough to release, because a merchant still asking to be paid has not been paid, yet a merchant that simultaneously reports a settled payment has contradicted itself and only one reading is safe. Releasing on any of these hands budget back for money that moved, and lets an autonomous caller pay a second time; the S15 audit reproduced exactly that as O44 against attempt 1 of 2 with status 403. Note what does *not* change: a non-2xx that claims no settlement still releases, which is the neighbouring refusal-releases-redirect-does-not vector.
